case01_funding-1: SELECT round_id, startup, deal_date FROM funding_rounds WHERE deal_date > '2020-01-22'
case01_funding-2: SELECT COUNT(*) AS rounds FROM funding_rounds WHERE LOWER(city_raw) LIKE '%bangalore%' OR LOWER(city_raw) LIKE '%bengaluru%'
case01_funding-3: SELECT LOWER(TRIM(startup)) AS startup_key, deal_date, amount_usd, COUNT(*) AS copies FROM funding_rounds WHERE amount_usd IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
case01_funding-4: WITH r AS (SELECT strftime('%Y', deal_date) AS year, startup, amount_usd, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY strftime('%Y', deal_date) ORDER BY amount_usd DESC, round_id) AS rn FROM funding_rounds WHERE amount_usd IS NOT NULL AND deal_date IS NOT NULL) SELECT year, startup, amount_usd FROM r WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY year
case01_funding-5: SELECT investor, COUNT(*) AS rounds FROM round_investors GROUP BY investor ORDER BY rounds DESC, investor LIMIT 5
case02_quickcommerce-1: SELECT order_id, platform, ROUND(distance_km / (delivery_min / 60.0), 1) AS speed_kmh FROM orders WHERE delivery_min > 0 AND distance_km / (delivery_min / 60.0) > 80
case02_quickcommerce-2: SELECT o.platform, COUNT(*) AS orders, ROUND(100.0 * AVG(CASE WHEN o.delivery_min > p.promised_min THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS late_pct FROM orders o JOIN platforms p ON p.platform = o.platform GROUP BY o.platform ORDER BY late_pct DESC, o.platform
case02_quickcommerce-3: SELECT order_id, COUNT(*) AS payouts, ROUND(SUM(amount), 2) AS total_paid FROM rider_payouts GROUP BY order_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
case02_quickcommerce-4: WITH s AS (SELECT city, platform, AVG(delivery_min) AS a FROM orders WHERE city IS NOT NULL GROUP BY city, platform HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20), r AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY a, platform) AS rn FROM s) SELECT city, platform, ROUND(a, 1) AS avg_min FROM r WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY city
case03_catalog-1: SELECT sku_id, name, available_qty FROM products WHERE out_of_stock = 1 AND available_qty > 0
case03_catalog-2: SELECT sku_id, mrp, discount_pct, selling_price FROM products WHERE ABS(selling_price - mrp * (100 - discount_pct) / 100.0) > 2
case03_catalog-3: SELECT c.aisle_no, p.category, ROUND(SUM(p.selling_price * p.available_qty), 2) AS stock_value FROM products p JOIN categories c ON c.category = p.category WHERE p.out_of_stock = 0 GROUP BY c.aisle_no, p.category ORDER BY stock_value DESC, c.aisle_no
case03_catalog-4: SELECT category, name, weight_g, MIN(selling_price) AS min_price, MAX(selling_price) AS max_price FROM products GROUP BY category, name, weight_g HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT selling_price) > 1
case04_upi-1: SELECT CAST(strftime('%H', ts) AS INTEGER) AS hour, COUNT(*) AS txns, ROUND(100.0 * AVG(fraud_flag), 2) AS fraud_rate_pct FROM transactions GROUP BY hour HAVING COUNT(*) >= 50 ORDER BY AVG(fraud_flag) DESC, hour LIMIT 1
case04_upi-2: SELECT sender_bank, receiver_bank, ROUND(SUM(amount), 2) AS fraud_amount FROM transactions WHERE fraud_flag = 1 GROUP BY sender_bank, receiver_bank ORDER BY SUM(amount) DESC, sender_bank, receiver_bank LIMIT 3
case04_upi-3: SELECT txn_id, ts, amount FROM transactions WHERE status = 'SUCCESS' AND fraud_flag = 0 AND amount > 50000 AND strftime('%H', ts) < '05'
case04_upi-4: SELECT CASE WHEN b.is_private = 1 THEN 'private' ELSE 'public' END AS bank_type, COUNT(*) AS txns, ROUND(100.0 * AVG(t.fraud_flag), 2) AS fraud_rate_pct FROM transactions t JOIN banks b ON b.bank = t.sender_bank GROUP BY bank_type
case05_payroll-1: SELECT p.pay_id, p.emp_id, p.pay_month FROM payroll p JOIN employees e ON e.emp_id = p.emp_id WHERE e.exit_date IS NOT NULL AND p.pay_month || '-01' > e.exit_date
case05_payroll-2: SELECT bank_account, COUNT(*) AS employees FROM employees GROUP BY bank_account HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
case05_payroll-3: SELECT p.pay_id, p.emp_id, p.net_pay, e.monthly_income FROM payroll p JOIN employees e ON e.emp_id = p.emp_id WHERE p.net_pay > 1.5 * e.monthly_income
case05_payroll-4: SELECT e.department, d.cost_centre, ROUND(SUM(p.net_pay), 2) AS leaked, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.net_pay) DESC) AS leak_rank FROM payroll p JOIN employees e ON e.emp_id = p.emp_id JOIN departments d ON d.department = e.department WHERE e.exit_date IS NOT NULL AND p.pay_month || '-01' > e.exit_date GROUP BY e.department, d.cost_centre ORDER BY leak_rank, e.department
case00_training-1: SELECT * FROM funding_rounds ORDER BY round_id LIMIT 5
case00_training-2: SELECT startup, amount_usd FROM funding_rounds WHERE amount_usd >= 50000000 ORDER BY amount_usd DESC, startup
case00_training-3: SELECT COUNT(*) AS undisclosed FROM funding_rounds WHERE amount_usd IS NULL
